mapper.select: SELECT b.bom_id, b.parent_item_code, b.component_item_code, b.required_qty, b.unit, b.active, b.created_at, b.updated_at, parent_item.item_name AS parent_item_name, component_item.item_name AS component_item_name FROM bom b JOIN item parent_item ON parent_item.item_code = b.parent_item_code JOIN item component_item ON component_item.item_code = b.component_item_code ORDER BY b.bom_id

SELECT b.bom_id, b.parent_item_code, b.component_item_code, b.required_qty, b.unit, b.active, b.created_at, b.updated_at, parent_item.item_name AS parent_item_name, component_item.item_name AS component_item_name FROM bom b JOIN item parent_item ON parent_item.item_code = b.parent_item_code JOIN item component_item ON component_item.item_code = b.component_item_code WHERE b.bom_id = #{bomId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bom ( parent_item_code, component_item_code, required_qty, unit, active ) VALUES ( #{parentItemCode}, #{componentItemCode}, #{requiredQty}, #{unit}, #{active} )
mapper.update: UPDATE bom SET parent_item_code = #{parentItemCode}, component_item_code = #{componentItemCode}, required_qty = #{requiredQty}, unit = #{unit}, active = #{active} WHERE bom_id = #{bomId}
